title: Ruby2Shell: heap overflow in Ruby String case conversion for single-byte encodings, remote code execution reported for Rails and Sinatra in default configuration

variants.label: GitLab bundled Ruby
variants.remedy: upgrade GitLab to 19.6.1, 19.5.8 or 19.4.10 or later, which bundle Ruby 3.3.14; the package upgrade restarts the services

no_listener_text: exposure depends on whether this process handles untrusted text in a legacy encoding (job workers, scripts)
remedy: upgrade the Ruby interpreter to 3.3.14 / 3.4.13 / 4.0.10 (rbenv, RVM, image rebuild or the distro package; 3.2 and older get no upstream fix) and restart the application servers and job workers; updating Rails or other gems does not fix it

CVE-2026-132825.summary: one-byte heap overflow in upcase/swapcase/downcase(:fold)/casecmp? on ISO-8859-x and Windows-125x strings; UTF-8 not affected; reported reachable without authentication in Rails and classic Sinatra
